name: States of Brazil
author: Addicting Games
description: States of Brazil is an educational game about the states of Brazil. The key to learning geography is repetition, and this online game does just that. Play this map game over and over again until you memorize every state in Brazil. Tocantins, Acre, and Santa Catarina are just 3 of the 27 beautiful states of Brazil that you must identify. There are many reasons why anyone would want to learn about Brazil’s geography. Maybe you want to visit the country or maybe you need to study for a geography test. Maybe you just like having a vast knowledge of geography! Whatever the reason, do not hesitate to play this fun quiz game about the states of brazil. Play Geography has a vast series of map games to help expand your knowledge.
